notes.title: Achievement system and Chinese language support!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/673d33401024d0fca06db0be12c728ff5f4a41de.png[/img]

[b]Hello, Explorers![/b]

We're proud to bring you the latest update of version V1.3.0. We're excited to introduce the highly requested [b]Achievement System[/b], allowing you to showcase your discoveries and unlock impressive milestones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/2e77cd5a266878bd079fd922d382bff143679c83.png[/img]

In addition, we're happy to announce that we've[b] fully localized GemCrusty in the Chinese language![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/4bcde55644e8ad8661af43941caba53f17d8b2f9.png[/img]

As always, we've minor bugs fixed and made some improvements in the game.

Patch Notes:

Introducing the Steam Achievement System.
Complete localization in the Chinese language! 
Minor bug fixes and improvements.

We hope you enjoy the new features and updates in GemCrusty. Happy digging, discovering, dating, and hunting for achievements!

notes.title: We've Heard You!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/c5bb9705d02157bb96e9a1e6b37751627ad844d0.png[/img]

We have been listening to your discussions about the unusual English phrases and grammar in the GemCrusty. 

We have made our best to translate from our language to English, yet we notice that many of the dialogues may not be flawless. There are still some issues with the English in the game. Therefore, we kindly request your assistance in helping us with the translation!

notes.title: Added new dialogue for Silvare, new bomb types and patterns!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Explorers![/b][/h1]

We're excited to announce the release of version 1.2.0 , which includes new bomb patterns, bomb spawn chance and rebalanced final boss fight. We also added more dialogue for our lovely, fluffy Silvare! We appreciate all of your support and feedback as we continue to improve the game.

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

Added new bomb types and patterns.
[list]
[*] New bomb pattern will be generated at deeper levels of the mine.
[*] Added new dialogue for Silvare.
[*] Added notification bubble for Silvare when he comes with new dialogue.
[*] Combo ore rotation around the player will now be hidden when the player is in the gem girls' room.
[*] Final boss fights now have a chance to drop Health Restoration as rewarded for slaying moles during the combat.
[*] Remove low-rewarded patterns in deeper levels.
[*] DLCs will now be shown in the main menu and directly linked to the game's downloadable content store.
[*] Improved some in-game UI.
[*] Minor bug have been fixed.
[/list]

New bomb!!💣
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/d5819f0b2f343c776611e443e912d659ea4fab08.png[/img]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

Fixed: Framerate now will be accurate with Screen Resolution in Option Menu.
Fixed: Player cannot move during the combat for certain situation.

Happy digging, discovering, and dating in GemCrusty, The Explorers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/31b6b172bb3ea63d6a2ee93dbf93da7a88347bbd.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix patches for version 1.1.07
notes.content:
[b]Hello The Explorers![/b]

We're releasing hotfix patches for [b]version 1.1.07[/b] , which includes important bug fixes, localization updates, and more. We appreciate all of your support and feedback as we continue to improve the game.

Patch Note

Added [b]new sound effects.[/b]
Added [b]"Actual Ending Cutscene"[/b] which should appear after the end credits are finished.

(We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. As of version 1.1.0, we were unable to add the ending cutscene due to technical problems. If you have already completed "Ending Cutscene" and would like to experience the "Actual Ending Cutscene", you can delete your existing save files and start a new game. It's all part of the plan to destroy your keyboard! Just kidding!😂)

Bug Fixes

Now the game will be saved upon exiting to the title screen or exiting to the desktop.
Fixed: Player's character is getting stuck in certain directions during the combat.
Fixed: Issue where the pause menu could be closed while another menu is active.
Fixed: Issue where the selected icon was visible in the credit scene on the main menu.
Fixed: "Relationship Increases" visual effect appearing on a gem girls that has already reached the maximum relationship level.
Fixed:  Thai vowels not displaying correctly in the intro cutscene.
Fixed: Minor UI glitches.

Thank you, Explorers! Have a fantastic day, and happy digging, discovering, and dating in GemCrusty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/e7bdd623c2d9481f853b154b3acb4e4a5c3f8187.png[/img]

notes.title: GemCrusty - Free-to-Play Casual Mining Game is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Explorers! We're excited to announce that GemCrusty is now live on Steam! In this exciting casual mining game, you'll put on your miner hat, grab your pickaxe, and dig deep into the mine to collect precious gems. But beware of pesky little moles and tricky obstacles that may stand in your way!

In GemCrusty, you'll also get to interact with the mysterious gemstones that are actually girls! These gem girls have been hidden away in the underground world, waiting for someone like you to achieve their dreams and become the most beautiful shining gems in the world. Will you be the one to uncover their true potential?

With its beautiful and anime-inspired art style, GemCrusty offers a rewarding gameplay experience that's perfect for players of all ages. So what are you waiting for? Start digging and collecting those precious gems today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796797/d9a5c6f0f176bf08068bc78d8e3044260e2c1a4c.png[/img]
